feature: Payment Exception Report harian dan bulanan (PS-PRA, TS-PAM, refund) dikirim lewat email
story: Tidak ada di OCMS43.1-43.5; mirip OCMS46.8 / OCMS47.9 (laporan ringkasan refund harian)
type: Kode tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Laporan Excel terpisah berisi notice PS-PRA, TS-PAM, dan refund pada tanggal laporan, dikirim lewat email (source PAYMENT_EXCEPTION_REPORT) oleh job 1 scheduler harian dan bulanan. Bukan 'error' pada OCMS43.4. Header helper dan query saya baca; template email dan penerima asli tidak. Mungkin dicakup story refund di epic 46/47 (46.8 Removed, 47.9 Replacement); belum dicek di luar chunk ini.
note_en: A separate Excel report of PS-PRA, TS-PAM and refund notices for the report date, sent by email (source PAYMENT_EXCEPTION_REPORT) as job 1 of the daily and monthly schedulers. It is not the 'errors' of OCMS43.4. I read the helper header and query; the email template and real recipients I did not. It may be covered by the refund stories in epics 46/47 (46.8 Removed, 47.9 Replacement); not checked outside this chunk.

feature: Payment Acceptance Cutoff untuk notice court (payment_acceptance_allowed=N setelah court_payment_due_date lewat), hanya lewat POST manual
story: Tidak jelas (dipakai sebagai bukti parsial di OCMS43.1 langkah 2; story court lain belum dicek)
type: Kode tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Job mematikan flag payment untuk notice yang court_payment_due_date-nya sudah lewat, tetapi pemanggilannya di scheduler Toppan day-end dikomentari (baris 123) dan UPDATE hanya mengubah VON tanpa is_sync='N'. Hanya jalan lewat POST manual. Cakupan story court di luar chunk ini belum dicek.
note_en: The job switches off the payment flag for notices whose court_payment_due_date has passed, but its call in the Toppan day-end scheduler is commented out (line 123) and the UPDATE only changes VON without is_sync='N'. It only runs through a manual POST. Court story coverage outside this chunk was not checked.

note_en: An hourly cron (cron.urapgretry.schedule=0 0 * * * ?, enabled=true) sends AXS transactions with urapg_sync_status=N to URA PG. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-035, OCMS-DF-2026-047, OCMS-DF-2026-147 concern this job. I only read the wrapper class and the properties; the UraPgServiceImpl implementation and the payload to the gateway: cannot verify from repo.

feature: Refund otomatis untuk pembayaran lebih atau pembayaran pada notice yang sudah FP/PRA atau PS-APP (createRefundNotice di CronSyncTxnData)
story: Mirip OCMS46.1 (No requirement); tidak ada di OCMS43.2
type: Kode tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Saat sync transaksi, pembayaran lebih, pembayaran ganda, atau pembayaran setelah PS-APP tidak diterapkan lagi tetapi membuat record refund (ocms_refund_notice). OCMS43.2 hanya menyebut tandai dibayar, jadi tidak dipakai sebagai bukti. Pembuatan refund advice ke Cumulus di story 46.x tidak ditelusuri di sini.
note_en: During transaction sync an overpayment, a duplicate payment, or a payment after PS-APP is not applied again but creates a refund record (ocms_refund_notice). OCMS43.2 only says mark as paid, so it is not used as evidence. The refund advice to Cumulus in the 46.x stories was not traced here.
